note: A curated set of Poly Haven's fabric textures for tosijs-3d's cloth materials, re-encoded small: each fabric in two tiers, lite (512 px colour + normal) and full (1024 px colour + normal, 512 px greyscale roughness), from the 1K originals (cached under source/, not published). fabrics.json is the manifest (names, authors, the metres one tile covers, files). Built by static-assets bin/polyhaven-fabrics.ts: `bun bin/polyhaven-fabrics.ts`. Normals are OpenGL convention (glTF's).
